items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: Because they only had two trumpets and a trombone, Ed Lewis and Booker Washington and Thman Hayes. But when I came in, then that made four of us.

ctx.x: Because they only had two trumpets and a trombone, Ed Lewis and Booker Washington and Thman Hayes. But
when I came in, then that made four of us. Then when Lips came in, that made five. Then they added another trumpet, it made six.
